name: A brief, and nobody has picked it up yet

mapBrief.text:
# Northgate Library — Digital Membership Renewal

## Background

Northgate Library District serves 41,000 cardholders across six branches. Membership is free but must be renewed every two years, in person at a service desk.

## What we think we need

A way for a cardholder to renew without making the trip, without weakening the proof-of-residence check the state requires of us.
